Name: ( Daisy's Redux ) Jas Edition
Author: sunsetfarm
Description:
[center][font=Verdana]﻿[size=5]Daisy's Redux : Jas Edition!
[/size]A Portrait Mod by Sunsetfarm
V. 1.0

[size=2][b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
[/b][/size]It redesigns Jas's vanilla portraits and character sprites to make them a bit cuter.
This redesign is based off of my headcanon that Marnie's family is Latinx,
Jas herself being Afro-Latina.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL :[/b]
❧ Download and Unzip file
❧ Backup the [b]original Jas.xnb[/b] files in both the [b]Characters[/b] and [b]Portraits[/b] folders
❧ Copy and Paste the [b]modded Jas.xnb[/b] files into those folders
❧ Allow the modded files to replace the originals
❧ Run your game and enjoy!


[u]If you have any questions about the mod, please feel free to ask!
[/u]

[b]FUTURE PLANS :[/b]
❧ Redraw Jas's hair to make it look more natural 
❧ Portrait Mods for the rest of Marnie's household ( Marnie + Shane )
❧ Portrait Mods for Jodi and Vincent
❧ Portrait Mods for Evelyn, Sandy, and Pam
❧ Portrait Mods for Abigail + Her Parents
❧ New NPCS*
❧ Rival Events for Abigail / Haley, Maru / Penny, and Emily / Sandy*

[size=1]* I still have a few more things to learn when it comes to modding so these are currently just ideas[/size]
